study.title: Real-time Crop Classification Using Edge Computing and Deep Learning
study.short_title: Real-time Crop Classification Using Edge Computing and Deep Learning
study.venue: 2020 IEEE 17th Annual Consumer Communications & Networking Conference (IEEE CCNC)

dataset.name: NCHU experimental farm (rice and corn plots), DJI Matrice 100 + Logitech C925e webcam (1920x1080)
dataset.note: Flight heights 30 m and 40 m give 2.21 cm/pix and 2.94 cm/pix GSD; captured Nov-18-2018; labels: rice, corn, road, background.

mIoU.ambiguity: mIoU not reported; per-class recall and overall accuracy used.

PA.ambiguity: Overall accuracy (89.44%) of SegNet on crop species classification; abstract rounds to 89%.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Crop-type classification study (rice/corn), no weed class.

edge.device: NVIDIA GTX 1080 (remote inference server); ASUS Tinker Board S (on-drone edge capture/relay)

fps.quote: The average inference speed of the semantic image segmentation model is 0.7s with segmentation identification accuracy is 89%.
fps.ambiguity: Derived as 1/0.7 s from reported average inference time; inference runs on backend GTX 1080 server, not on the drone.

latency_ms.quote: The average inference speed of the semantic image segmentation model is 0.7s with segmentation identification accuracy is 89%.
latency_ms.ambiguity: Pure inference time; end-to-end capture-to-display adds ~3-4 s transmission delay over 4G.

issues: Inference executed on remote GTX 1080 backend (not on-drone edge); on-drone board only captures and relays frames
